source.title: Neural control of body-plan axis in regenerating planaria

injury: short fragment containing one head, cut in the 2H worm

intervention.timing: 3 day soak after cutting of the original worm; recut at least 1 month after completed regeneration
intervention.description: Worms with a head at each end (made earlier with octanol) cut to leave a short fragment carrying one head
